CustomField.formula: BLANKVALUE(Account.BillingStreet, "") & IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Account.BillingStreet)) && ( NOT(ISBLANK(Account.BillingCity)) || NOT(ISBLANK(Account.BillingState)) || NOT(ISBLANK(Account.BillingPostalCode)) || NOT(ISBLANK(Account.BillingCountry)) ), ", ", "" ) & BLANKVALUE(Account.BillingCity, "") & IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Account.BillingCity)) && ( NOT(ISBLANK(Account.BillingState)) || NOT(ISBLANK(Account.BillingPostalCode)) || NOT(ISBLANK(Account.BillingCountry)) ), ", ", "" ) & BLANKVALUE(Account.BillingState, "") & IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Account.BillingState)) && ( NOT(ISBLANK(Account.BillingPostalCode)) || NOT(ISBLANK(Account.BillingCountry)) ), " ", "" ) & BLANKVALUE(Account.BillingPostalCode, "") & IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Account.BillingPostalCode)) && NOT(ISBLANK(Account.BillingCountry)), ", ", "" ) & BLANKVALUE(Account.BillingCountry, "")
CustomField.label: Household Address
